popup.networkStructures.dateMeaningSigna: HTTP Last-Modified file time, not a per-point inspection date
popup.networkStructures.dateMeaningOffic: Official metadata update time, not a survey date
popup.networkStructures.carrierCaution: Each record is an OSM way segment; one bridge may include several records.
popup.networkStructures.footprintCaution: Native outline, not completed with buffers; no outline does not mean no bridge.
popup.networkStructures.stage1Supported: Location and undirected local direction supported
popup.networkStructures.stage1MissingRel: Marked supported but the stage1 release is missing; stays pending confirmation
popup.networkStructures.fixedGlyph: Fixed 30 m direction indicator, not the bridge length
popup.networkStructures.maxGlyph: Fixed direction indicator of up to 30 m, not the bridge length
popup.networkStructures.pointNoLine: Not provided; a point does not imply a direction line
popup.networkStructures.statusValue: In progress, site-owner only; not a confirmed bridge body or network
popup.networkStructures.elevatedHint: Elevated hint present; still to be re-checked
popup.networkStructures.tierStage1Local: New direction candidate inferred from a nearby bridge line with the same direction; the unique reference is not confirmed
popup.networkStructures.tierNoCrossing: No waterway crossing; direction reference from the nearest ordinary route with a distance advantage, low confidence
popup.networkStructures.tierNoWaterwayCo: Common direction of several bridge-tagged carrier lines; no usable waterway crossing, low confidence
popup.networkStructures.tierTiedConsensu: Common direction of several ordinary routes crossing a waterway; low confidence
popup.networkStructures.tierMultiBridge: Direction reference from several bridge-tagged candidate lines crossing a waterway; same bridge not confirmed
popup.networkStructures.tierWaterway: Direction reference from an ordinary route crossing a waterway; not confirmed as a bridge
popup.networkStructures.tierCurved: Local direction reference from a bridge-tagged line; span direction not confirmed
popup.networkStructures.tierOrdinary: Direction reference from the ordinary road network; not an identified bridge line
popup.networkStructures.tierOsmEntity: Whole OSM bridge entity geometry (v5 match); identity still to be reviewed
popup.networkStructures.dirSourceNoCross: OSM ordinary route not tagged as a bridge (distance advantage)
popup.networkStructures.dirSourceNoWater: Several OSM bridge-tagged carrier lines (same direction)
popup.networkStructures.nearbyBridgeLine: {ids}; may have several values and does not imply a unique reference
popup.networkStructures.sameWayCount: Candidate records on the same OSM way
popup.networkStructures.sharedYes: Yes; this cannot be taken as different bridges
popup.networkStructures.sharedNo: No sharing found; identity still unchecked
popup.networkStructures.representativeWa: This ID is only the selected representative way, not the full candidate set
popup.networkStructures.supplementalYes: A new 30 m direction mark was added; not counted as imagery support
popup.networkStructures.pointToRef: Registered point to reference line / crossing
popup.networkStructures.lineRoleValue: Direction reference only; not a verified network edge
popup.networkStructures.candidateWayIds: Candidate OSM way IDs (no single line selected)
popup.networkStructures.limitsConsensus: Point direction indicator only; no route or carrier line was selected and same-bridge or elevated form was not checked, so it cannot be used for network connectivity analysis.
popup.networkStructures.nearestMargin: Closer than the next-nearest route by
popup.networkStructures.limitsNearest: The nearest route is a direction reference only; it is not confirmed as the bridge body, its ends, or a passable edge.
popup.networkStructures.legacyQa: Legacy overall QA (not this phase's location / direction threshold)
popup.networkStructures.legacyQaPassed: Previously passed source-point matching, local direction and classification checks
popup.networkStructures.legacyQaFailed: Negative observation; still to be handled
popup.networkStructures.legacyQaUnknown: Reviewed but evidence is insufficient; still to be checked
popup.networkStructures.legacyQaNone: Legacy overall check not yet completed
popup.networkStructures.sampleRisk: Risk-stratified check (not counted in the formal sampling rate)
popup.networkStructures.legacyQaDate: Legacy overall QA check date (not the imagery date)
popup.networkStructures.legacyQaImagery: Legacy overall QA independent imagery source
popup.networkStructures.stage1ScopeValue: The full shape is not required; local direction is not the bridge ends, engineering length or a network edge, and does not confirm a named bridge, classification or entity de-duplication
popup.networkStructures.stage1OverallVal: Formal 300: 103 supported, 2 negative, 195 undetermined; 3% not yet proven and cannot be extrapolated to all of Taiwan; v5 lines were not re-sampled
popup.networkStructures.networkEdgeStatu: Unverified; cannot be used directly for accessibility calculations
popup.networkStructures.lenFixed: Short fixed-direction line centered on the registered point; not the bridge body, endpoints or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.lenMultiBridge: Short line near the waterway crossing of several OSM bridge candidates; does not imply the same bridge, endpoints or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.lenWaterway: Short line of an ordinary OSM route at a waterway crossing; does not represent the bridge body, endpoints or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.lenCurved: Short local segment of a bridge-tagged OSM way, possibly an approach road; does not represent the bridge body or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.lenOrdinary: Short local segment of an ordinary OSM route; does not represent the bridge body, endpoints or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.lenOsmEntity: Total length of member segments of the OSM bridge entity (including all lanes, not clipped to the registered range); not the BSS registered or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.lenDefault: Drawn direction candidate; not a registered, measured or engineering length
popup.networkStructures.v5Limits: None of the 23,276 v5 lines (17,830 whole OSM bridge entities, 206 New Taipei official end-to-end approximate axes, 5,240 network inferences) is a reviewed physical bridge body; do not use them to count bridges, measure bridge length, or assess road connectivity or passability.
popup.networkStructures.ntCaution: The end-to-end line is an approximate position; the registered length uses the official value.
popup.networkStructures.cmpCaution: Candidate matching, not authoritative pairing; "OSM only" means no candidate was found in this official register, not that the official side omitted it.
popup.networkStructures.tnLimits: This is a historical inspection record; the source has no bridge system ID, score or live traffic status, so it cannot be merged directly with other bridge registers.
popup.networkStructures.registerIdValue: Not provided by the source; the map identifier is only for reproducing this data
popup.networkStructures.hcLimits: The end-to-end line is an approximate position, not the actual bridge body; it is not authoritatively paired with inspection records and says nothing about structural safety.
popup.networkStructures.tpLimits: Only the official registered point is shown; the directional length is the sum over directions, not the total tunnel length. Some endpoint distances do not match the registered length, so no assumed tunnel line is drawn. The source gives no data date or live traffic status.
popup.networkStructures.crsLimitValue: The source does not declare a CRS; WGS84 is only inferred from the value range. No data date or live traffic status is provided.
popup.networkStructures.chLimits: Each record is a signal register point, not necessarily a separate intersection; no live signal state, countdown or fault information.
